description: Kitsune are a charismatic and witty people with a connection to the spiritual that grants them many magical abilities, chiefly the power to shapechange into other forms.

features.name: Change Shape
features.tldr: You can magically transform into an alternate form, typically a human or a fox.

features.name: Ancestry Heritage
features.tldr: Choose a kitsune heritage reflecting your magical lineage or tail progression.
